 Sri Lankan Batter Kamil Mishara Sets New Record in Nepal Premier League
 Ratopati
 November 18, 2026
 Read in Nepali
 Kathmandu. Sri Lankan batter Kamil Mishara has set a new record in the Nepal Premier League (NPL). He has etched his name in the record books by becoming the player with the highest individual score in NPL history. 
 Mishara scored an unbeaten 120 runs off 59 balls with the help of 10 sixes and 5 fours. With his aggressive batting, the previous record for the highest individual score in the NPL has also been broken. Earlier, the record for the highest individual score in the NPL was 114 runs. Mishara has set a new record by surpassing it by 6 runs.
 Earlier, in the second edition of the NPL, Mark Watt of Karnali Yaks had scored an unbeaten 114 runs. In Mishara's innings, 60 runs came from 10 sixes and 20 runs from 5 fours. Thus, he scored 80 runs from boundaries alone. He batted at a strike rate of 203.39.
 Earlier, Scotland's Mark Watt had scored an unbeaten 114 off 44 balls against Lumbini Lions playing for Karnali Yaks in 2025. His innings included 12 sixes and 6 fours. Similarly, Adam Rosington scored 108 and Andries Gous scored 104.
 Chitwan has given Kathmandu a target of 205 runs. The team that wins today will face Sudurpaschim in the final.
